assessment.what_changed_en: Inserted three unsourced sentences asserting that Erkko forbade Mannerheim from disclosing a favourable Soviet land-exchange offer, costing 85,000 lives and making Erkko 'the number-one war criminal'.

assessment.uncertainty_note: Historians note that Mannerheim and Paasikivi favoured larger territorial concessions in autumn 1939 than Erkko believed Stalin would act upon, whereas the added text states an unverified ban on Mannerheim and labels Erkko a war criminal in Wikipedia's voice.
assessment.historical_note_en: Stalin offered roughly 5,529 km² of Soviet Karelia (Repola and Porajärvi) in exchange for strategic Karelian Isthmus territory, Gulf of Finland islands, and a naval base at Hanko—terms the Finnish cabinet and parliamentary groups unanimously considered incompatible with neutrality.
